title: Your guides stay on this Mac
body: Guides, screenshots, edits and exports are stored locally. No account or model download is needed. Imports and sharing happen only when you choose.
label: I reviewed local storage and sharing.

title: Review capture scope
body: Desktop recording follows your explicit Start and Stop actions. A selected-window scope and manual guide editing are also available.
label: Default capture mode

title: Allow Screen Recording
body: Enable Screen Recording for {app}. This permits screenshots during your recording; setup itself does not record your desktop.
help: In System Settings → Privacy & Security, enable {app}. If macOS requests a restart, quit and reopen {app}, then check again. Setup resumes here.

title: Allow Accessibility
body: Enable Accessibility for {app} so Copycat can identify controls and describe workflow actions. Normal typed characters are not stored as instructions.
help: In System Settings → Privacy & Security, enable {app}. If macOS requests a restart, quit and reopen {app}, then check again. Setup resumes here.

title: Review screenshots before sharing
body: Screenshots can contain private information. Review, crop and redact each guide before exporting. Automatic masking cannot guarantee that every secret is hidden.
label: I understand that I must review screenshots and instructions before sharing.

title: Optional browser extensions
body: Desktop recording works without an extension. You may skip this. Choosing a browser registers its local connector; install and enable the separate extension in that browser before using browser capture.
label: Browser extension

title: Review updates and quitting
body: {app} owns updates for this installed tool. Quitting during a recording asks whether to stop and save. A failed save keeps the app open.
label: I reviewed update ownership and safe shutdown.

title: Ready to use Copycat
body: Required setup is finished. You can revisit settings later; recording still requires your explicit Start.
